text: Two breaking removals lead the week: #12290 deletes code kept behind CLEAN27 in Service Management, including obsolete ES and IT objects, and #12293 does the same in Warehouse, so extensions still using those elements must be updated. Several new capabilities change behaviour. #12428 adds a public Copilot feature trial interface, #12207 marks MCP Data Query Tools as billable with a pricing acknowledgement before activation, and #12242 lifts the evaluation-company limit on Power BI report deployment. #11560 lets self-billed purchase invoices and credit memos export as Peppol BIS 3.0 e-documents, #12306 warns before releasing an already sent purchase order, and #12064 supports hash and percent characters in SharePoint paths. Other additions include #12213 (row and column definition preview), #11748 (bonded locations for excise tax), #11604 (Shopify delivery timestamp) and #10212 (SetReferenceType on SignedXml). Fixes cluster in manufacturing (#11959, #12188, #12059, #11994), Shopify (#12260, #12215, #12214, #12139), Subscription Billing (#10446, #11637, #10182), e-documents and tax reporting (#11629, #9347, #12055, #12127, #11848), and Email (#12118, #12463). Performance work covers #12078 for Excel export and #12307 for a set-based upgrade. BCQuality gained several knowledge articles, for example #213 and #215.

issues: #11848 is grouped under 'e-documents and tax reporting', but it fixes foreign currency opening balances in a G/L account sheet report (Report 11564). That is financial reporting, not tax reporting. Minor grouping imprecision.
